title: Pioneer Of Savoy Dies At Baytown
text:
Pioneer Of Savoy Dies At Baytown

(Herald News Service)

SAVOY — Mrs. Mammie McLemore, 80, native of Savoy and resident of this community 78 years, died Friday at 7:30 p. m. at the home of her son and daughter-in-law, Mr. and Mrs. Holly McLemore, at Baytown.

Mr. and Mrs. McLemore went to Baytown to make their home with their children two years. Mr. McLemore has been ill three years with paralysis. Mrs. McLemore's death came one week after she suffered a stroke of paralysis.

Funeral services will be held at the Savoy Church of Christ, but the time had not been set Saturday night. Burial will be in the Jenkins Cemetery, south of Savoy, with Earnheart-Strickland in charge.

Mrs. McLemore was born in Savoy on Christmas Day, 1870, and was the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Benjamin F. Arterberry. She was the last survivor of the Arterberry family.
